title: Personal Digital Twin — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Maintains a user-controlled model of selected preferences, projects, and workflows without assuming it perfectly represents the person. A proposed personal model that the user owns and controls: it tracks selected preferences, projects, and workflows to help software serve the user better — while being explicit that the model is a partial sketch, never a complete or perfect representation of the person. The user inspects, edits, and deletes anything in it.
capabilities: Maintain a user-controlled model of preferences and projects
Power personalized assistance from the model

Declare openly what the model does not capture
